notes.title: Update - September 8th 2025
notes.notes:
Latest Patch Notes:
- Added fade out effect for the aim target.
- Enemies are now slower in the earlier stages.
- Fixed issue related to the second ending not triggering properly.
- Fixed issue related to the new aim system affecting cutscenes.

notes.title: Improved mouse movement for the new Aim System
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The mouse movement for the new Aim System was a bit off. The latest update should fix that.

Good luck and have fun,
OcO

notes.title: Added full mouse movement to the new Aim System
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I've added full mouse control to the new Aim System, making it more intuitive.

Best and have fun,
OcO

notes.title: Aim System Rework
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,

After reviewing feedback from players, I've noticed that the biggest issue is with the aiming system.

This update is set to fix it with a rework, but I've also added the option in "Camera Settings" to switch back to the old one.

Best and have fun,[/p][p]OcO[/p]

notes.title: Update - 29.06.2025
notes.notes:
Current update:
- added ability to see through walls.
- finished adding achievements.
- Update to camera system.
- Added settings for adjusting the camera movement.

notes.title: Added Playtest V2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I've added a v2 of the Playtest version.

Players can now play up to the Labyrinth area of the game and can get access to the flashlight upgrade, which in turn gives access to 2 out of 3 secret areas.

Some of you might've also noticed that the game's name has changed from "Birthright" to "Bloodright".

This was done mainly to not confuse players as there were two other games with "Birthright" in the title.

Best and have fun,
OcO

notes.title: Small Update - 24.04.2025
notes.notes:
Working on sound design:
- Added an ambiance track for the save room.
- Smaller audio changes.

notes.title: Targeting System
notes.notes:
Currently working on making the Targeting System easier after receiving feedback.
- Pressing Right click will now show a transparent silhouette of the player behind walls to make targeting easier.
- Added more achievements and stats.
- General bug-fixing.

notes.title: Small Update - 11.04.2025
notes.notes:
A couple of smaller updates:
- small change to the save room tutorial to make it more clear what the player can interact with.
- added first 3 achievements.
- added stats.

notes.title: Players can now sign up for the Playtest version
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The Playtest version of "Birthright" is now live and in working condition.

Feel free to sign up whenever. 

Best and have fun,
OcO
